description: This file contains functions for reading and updating boot configuration entries on Qualcomm-based devices, as well as handling boot partition switching during firmware upgrades.

methods.name: bootconfig_find_entry
methods.description: Finds the offset of a specific partition entry within a boot configuration binary file by parsing its contents.

methods.name: bootconfig_rw_index
methods.description: Reads or writes the index value for a specific boot configuration entry, handling partition device retrieval and hex data manipulation.

methods.name: smempart_next_root
methods.description: Determines the next active root filesystem partition based on current state, swapping 'rootfs' and 'rootfs_1' as needed.

methods.name: elecom_upgrade_prepare
methods.description: Prepares for an upgrade by reading the current rootfs index and determining the next rootfs partition, reporting statuses via verbose logs.
